label: Matchings and augmenting paths
subgoals: Model allowed pin-slot pairs as bipartite edges
Grow the matching along alternating augmenting paths
Reduce to unit-capacity max flow when convenient

label: Greedy versus maximum
subgoals: Run a greedy pass and record the matched size
Find augmenting paths that shift earlier pins to free slots
Use Hopcroft-Karp for O(E root V) maximum matching

label: Covers and Hall's condition
subgoals: Equate maximum matching size with minimum vertex cover size
Use a cover as a certificate that no larger matching exists
Report a subset of pins with too few neighbours as the obstruction
